correctness.rationale: Spectral projectors for L(K_2,q) at 0,q,2,q+2 yield two diagonal entry classes d_A,d_B and positive off-diagonals by monotone g(z)=(z+6)/(z²+4z+6). Independent SymPy factored each diagonal rational numerator exactly as supplied A_q,B_q and independently recomputed Sylvester resultant -46656 q^4(q-2)^4(q+2)^10 F(q) with F=3q^6-64q^5-708q^4-2388q³-2375q²-1776q-576. Exact Sturm counts show no positive quartic root for integer 2<=q<=9; Descartes and explicit negative rational test values imply exactly two roots per quartic for real q>=10. F has unique positive zero q*=30.086536..., so order of negative intervals changes once between q=30 and 31; signs at q=10 and 31 fix root order globally. Numerically corroborated q=10,30,31,50 (q=10 boundaries approximately .5613097,1.0971926,3.0537513,5.7791663). Three safe bands for 10<=q<=30, two for q>=31, unconditional q<=9. No claims about internal-stage positivity; infinite all-q theorem follows from sign/resultant argument, not finite matrices.

value.rationale: A natural full step-size topology classification for a standard L-stable implicit method on complete-bipartite graph heat flow, identifying a merger of two forbidden bands with sharp integer threshold 30/31. This adds substantive information beyond generic small-step positivity, unconditional cutoff at graph order eleven and eventual large-step recovery; permits exact selection of safe nonmonotone timesteps.

limitations: K_2,q unweighted for integer q>=2 and completed endpoint map only; internal stage components may be negative.
